thesis: This episode argues that major technology companies are making significant, innovative contributions to research and product development, often surpassing traditional academic research institutions. It highlights specific achievements like the invention of the self-driving car and the iPhone, while also noting that some companies, like Cisco, have achieved innovation despite not having internal research goals.
